title: Reporting Ledger Changed Webhook
description: Optional account-anchored invalidation fired for every newly committed reporting revision or post-official adjustment, whether or not health changes. Valid in every reporting tier. Receivers repair from their own durable changes_after checkpoint through get_reporting_status; this event is never the source of truth.

idempotency_key.description: Random per distinct fire and stable across transport retries, scoped to the authenticated sender.

notification_id.description: Stable per committed ledger record; re-emissions reuse it.

x-adcp-validation.logical_record: One destination-independent revision or adjustment produces one logical account event even when it fans out through multiple obligations or delivery configurations. Receivers use changes_after to resolve the affected obligations and deduplicate by the immutable record identity.
